name: 26_stack_wooden_blocks
title: Stacking and Hiding Blocks on Table
summary: The robot stacks a red hexagon on a white block, conceals a blue cube beneath the block's arch, manipulates other objects, and later retrieves the hidden cube.
robot: one robot arm with a parallel gripper
setting: a wooden tabletop workspace with geometric blocks

source.original_prompt: pick up the red hexagon block and stack it on the white cuboid block

segments.instruction: The robot arm moves to the red hexagon block and closes its parallel gripper around it. The camera remains fixed on the table.
The robot lifts the red hexagon block, carries it leftward, and stacks it squarely on top of the white arched cuboid. The camera remains fixed.
The robot grasps the lower-left blue cube and slides it completely underneath the arched opening of the white block. The camera remains fixed.
segments.memory_event: hide: the blue cube is hidden under the white arched block

segments.instruction: The robot releases the cube, moves to the tall white cylinder in the center ring, and lifts it slightly before seating it firmly back down. The camera remains fixed.
The robot moves to the right blue cube, picks it up, and sets it in the center foreground of the table. The camera remains fixed.
The robot reaches back to the arched white block and pulls out what was placed underneath it, setting it down to the left. The camera remains fixed.
segments.memory_event: return: the blue cube reappears from under the white arch, unchanged

segments.instruction: The robot grasps the right blue cube from the center and stacks it on top of the red hexagon block. The camera remains fixed.
The robot releases the stacked cube and retracts its gripper to an upright resting position above the table. The camera remains fixed.
